status_codes.200_ok: Cycle completed successfully, or idempotent cached outcome replayed
status_codes.400_bad_request: Invalid JSON payload or missing mandatory fields
status_codes.404_not_found: Task does not exist, or was deleted before/during cycle
status_codes.409_conflict: Optimistic revision mismatch, conflicting request_id payload, or concurrent cycle in flight
status_codes.500_internal_error: Internal orchestrator execution error with error logged

status_codes.404_not_found: Task or investigation store does not exist

backwards_compatibility: 100% compatible with RCA-2A.16 client payload shapes and response schemas
